name: WdScrollbarType
description: Specifies when scroll bars are available for the specified frame when viewing its frames page in a web browser.

constants.name: wdScrollbarTypeAuto
constants.description: Scroll bars are available for the specified frame only if the contents are too large to fit in the allotted space.

constants.name: wdScrollbarTypeYes
constants.description: Scroll bars are always available for the specified frame.

constants.name: wdScrollbarTypeNo
constants.description: Scroll bars are never available for the specified frame.
